question: Do colors arise or decay in ultimate Shiva?
premises: Colors such as blue shine in a jewel and a rainbow.
In Shiva, in ultimate reality, of these there is no arising.
In Shiva, in ultimate reality, of these there is no decay ever.
inference: Colors appear in substrates, but in ultimate Shiva they neither arise nor decay.
uncertainties: The referent of "these" is not fully explicit.
The compound "maṇāvindrāyudhe" may be parsed in more than one way.
plain_english: Just as blue and other colors shine in a jewel and a rainbow, so in Shiva, in ultimate reality, these neither arise nor ever decay.
